label: End-of-episode clock at D2 (final ~6 trials)
explanation: Fires only in the last ~10 trials of the 100-trial episode (essentially 0 activations before trial 90, 99.9% of mass in trials 90-99), and 95% of mass is at D2. It never fires at GO and rarely at D1. Activation ramps up trial by trial toward the episode end (example windows show monotonically increasing values across consecutive D2 steps), so it acts like a time-to-episode-end signal; all activations coincide with the lowest value-head bin (value < 5.2), consistent with low remaining expected return. Magnitude/rate is also higher when the reached state is S2 / the choice was a2 (in_state=S2 lift 4.2x vs 1.1x for S1), but it does not depend on reward, transition type or stay/switch. Predicate uses only the trial index and phase (observable / countable). Precision is incomplete because the onset trial varies across episodes and S1 trials often stay inactive; value<4 at D2 gives similar F1 (0.68) but is a model-internal correlate.
